info.schedule: Online, usually a minimum-bid round in July or August and a no-reserve round in the fall
info.note: Catalogs, inspector notes and results come from Title Check's tax-sale.info, which runs the auctions for most Michigan treasurers.

parcels.desc: Parcel appears to be a single platted lot in an unbuilt subdivision that is now intersected by US-41 in the Kipling area. No known road access and little use for anyone.
Parcel appears to be a single platted lot in an unbuilt subdivision that is now intersected by US-41 in the Kipling area. No known road access and little use for anyone.
~0.6 Acre Single Platted Lot with frontage on Mather Ave near Kipling. Likely unbuildable due to size, may be a goof purchase for an adjacent property owner.

Square 40 past a locked gate on a shared drive (Truax D Lane) in Cornell Township. The NW 1/3rd of this parcel is marshlands. The private road bisects the property from NE to SW ... it appears that several property owners to the SW also share use of this road to access parcels beyond to the south and west. We do not have explicit records of any access easement, but it seems likely to exist. The pr...

Parcel fronts 80' feet on the west side of BB Road and runs 275' feet deep. This is a nice uplands parcel in a quiet area a couple miles south of US 2. There is power at the road here that comes in from the south. We didn't see any trails cut into this parcel from the road.

A square 40 in Maple Ridge Township. No signs of any improvements or structures here. There is a two track in the area that crosses the NW corner of this parcel just barely, but it was impassable when we were there from downed trees and wet conditions. The SE 1/2 of the property is marshlands. It appears that the parcel to the north contains a camp so the trail is likely to be open again at some p...

We have offered this home before, and aren't sure why it's back. The original owner passed away before completing it, and it sat dormant for some time before owner #2 acquired it. That has probably been a four or five years, and now it's back !  There has been work done since the last time were here, but it still has no signs of a deep well, septic or power service. There is a nice pond and a grea...

Older one story bungalow on Escanaba's north side. Has a newer looking roof. Exterior does have some deferred maintenance and trim needs some paint and maybe rot repair in a few spots. Fiberboard panel outside. The lot is very small and does not run all the way to the alley to the rear. There is no off street parking at all for this unit. 1 or 2BR depending on your use, 1BA, Michigan cellar under ...

Two story wood frame structure in Escanaba north of downtown. It appears to possibly have been used as a duplex in the past, as it has dual electric and dual natural gas services. It is not currently in city records as a legal duplex. It is occupied as of the time of our visit in early June. The roof is old and looks sketch. If it isn't leaking yet, it will be before long. So that will need a refr...
Located near the northern city limit boundary, this is a double lot. Municipal water, sewer and natural gas are available here. Has an alley to the rear/west.

Older two story wood frame home in Gladstone. This property was still occupied (?) at the time of our visit in early June. Mid-life roof shows signs of shingle stress. Aluminum siding and trim could use paint. We suspect this is a mid-century remodel of an earlier century home. Poured veneered concrete foundation looks okay from the roadside. Likely a newer high efficiency natural gas forced air f...

Approximately 25,000 square feet of cold storage space in a large solid clear-span building that was reportedly a wood flooring mill in its original incarnation. There are at least 3 (2 artesian) and possibly as many as 5 wells on this parcel. The structures appear to be solid and straight. There is a small roof leak in the smaller of the two buildings. There is a very large amount of personal pro...

The subject property is a 10-acre property located on the west side of Bay Shore Drive between the road and the railroad tracks to the west. The parcel is north of the Days River 24.5 Road and Bay Shore Drive intersection about 3.5 miles north of Gladstone MI. The property does have legal road access to Bay Shore Drive that we have marked with pink survey tape in the "Pass with Care" and fence cor...

The subject property is a ~58.1-acre property located on the north side of Days River 24.5 Road northwest of the Stagecoach Q 5 intersection about 6 miles north of Gladstone MI. The property does not have legal road access to Days River 24.5 Road and is surrounded by 3 adjacent private landowners. The property is zoned within the Resource Production District which requires a minimum of 20-acres wi...

The subject property has about ~0.1-acre of usable land located on the west side of US-2 north of the Mather Avenue intersection about 1.5 miles north of Gladstone MI. The property does not have legal road access to US-2 and is adjacent to two private landowners to the north and west. Only the NW part of the subject property isn't within the US-2 road ROW. DNR granted MDOT a road easement over 85%...

We placed pink survey tape at the approximate east and west lines of this parcel where they meet Brampton Road. Roughly half of this parcel sits significantly below road grade and behind a guard rail. Sale 10038 is adjacent to the SE and the two properties touch at that corner only. The subject property is a ~40-acre property located on the south side of Brampton 27.5 Road west of the US-2 interse...

The subject property is a ~40-acre property located on the south side of Brampton 27.5 Road west of the US-2 intersection about 2 miles west of Rapid River MI. The property does not have legal road access to Brampton 27.5 Road and is surrounded by 6 adjacent private landowners. The property is zoned within the Resource Production District which requires a minimum of 20-acres with no width requirem...

The property does have legal platted access but those roads have not been fully constructed (i.e. 13th and 12th Avenues going northerly of M35). 1-acre parcel located south of Lake Shore Drive near the M-35 intersection on the south side of Escanaba MI. The property is adjacent to a private landowner and has road access to S Grant Avenue and Lake Shore Drive (both non-constructed platted roads) which leads to the currently maintained Lake Shore Drive. The plated non-constructed Lake Shore Drive is located near the powerlines that run paral...

The subject property is a ~39+ acre property located west of the M35 and F Lane intersection about 18 miles south of Escanaba MI. The property is surrounded by 5 private landowners and does not have legal road access. F Lane is not currently maintained west of M35 per the Act 51 map. The property is zoned within the Rural Residential District which requires a minimum of 1-acre and 165 feet of widt...

The subject property is a ~14.8-acre property located on the east side of US-41 south of the 36.5 Road intersection about 9.5 miles north of Rapid River MI. The property dimensions of the subject are 490' (north-south) X 1320' (east-west). There are 3 adjacent landowners: 2 private landowners to the north and east and US Forest Service property to the south. After talking with the Masonville Towns...

Corner lot at the NW corner of the intersection of 10th Avenue N and Stephenson Ave. It appears that the neighbor drives across this property to access their back yard. They really don't have that right .... Level, open lot. The SEV here is crazy high for a vacant lot, so we assume that a home has been removed from this parcel.
Two platted lots in Gladstone, on N 15th Street. The soils here would require filling and may be wetlands. Investigate prior to bidding as to your intended use

This was Jakes Boneyard, a scrap metal and other general accumulator of debris. This site was contaminated with numerous things such as waste oil, coolants and other liquids that were leaching into the water table. The EPA stepped in to assist Delta County with site remediation and they removed 300 tons of contaminated soil from this site. The complete report is attached below under related docume...

Beat up, stinky old singlewide on a 100' x 100' lot near Brampton. There is a load of debris in the yard to remove, and another load inside ... OR you can load what's in the yard inside and have the whole mess hauled off. There is a wood frame addition that has noticeable floor deflection. You'd need a miracle to make this into a decent living space again. The value here is in the land, well and s...

Parcel does not front on any improved public road. Nearest trail that we saw was about 100 feet off the NW corner of the parcel. And that is a gated road, conrolled by the former owner of this parcel, who also owns property to the north. A square 40 acres more or less. The east 1/4 of the property is marshlands. Off Truax D Lane.

Parcel is a platted lot in Fairbanks Township, near Garden. This is a very nice, ~1/2 acre wooded lot near the Puffy Bay boat launch in Big Bay deNoc / Lake Michigan. The lot is literally a couple hundred feet from the boat launch. Let your imagination run wild! An area of mostly well-maintained seasonal residences.
Parcel sits a couple feet below road grade and is brush covered. ~229 feet along the road and ~191' feet or so deep.

Older wood frame home that has had some updating done. It is occupied, so we could not view it in great detail. Has a newer roof, but there is a noticeable deflection and some discoloration. Steel barn to the rear is missing the doors. Some accumulation of "man stuff" in the yard. Appears to be a bi-level design. 1/4 acre lot is irregular in shape and has only 60' feet on the road.
One square acre, 208.75' x 208.75'. Fronts on K.5 Road. Knee deep in marsh. A perfect gift for the frog farmer or cattail rancher on your gift list.

Older 2 story home in Wells. There are visible issues with the roof that you can see from the roadside. The property is occupied, so we could not view it in great detail. There are accumulations in the yard that include inoperable vehicles, a half dozen campers and RVs, some piles of garbage, and other "man stuff" items ... some of which are titled items that we do not have title rights that we ca...

Corner lot at the NW corner of the intersection of 10th Avenue N and Stephenson Ave. It appears that the neighbor drives across this property to access their back yard. They really don't have that right .... Level, open lot. The SEV here is crazy high for a vacant lot, so we assume that a home has been removed from this parcel.

~15.83 Acres on Ludington St in Escanaba. Located West of town on US-2. Front of parcel is mostly clear while the back is wooded. USGS topographical map suggests a portion of the parcel contains wetlands. Could be a great site for development, check with the local zoning folks to ensure property is suitable for your intended use.

Vacant Lot with frontage on S 22nd Street. There is a narrow strip of property north of the row of pines that is *not* part of this parcel. Municipal water/sewer and natural gas here. Nice area of modern, well kept homes. There is a pile of building materials there... not sure who they belong to, but we have no title to them. Not sure if this is buildable due to the size, but Lot 7312 is adjacent ...

Vacant Lot near 22nd St. There is a narrow strip of property north of the row of pines that is *not* part of this parcel, preventing it from having any legal road access on  Municipal water/sewer and natural gas here. Nice area of modern, well kept homes. Lot 7311 is adjacent to the West and would provide lead access to this parcel. Pick them both up!

1.5 story, low maintenance exterior. Glass enclosed front porch. This home was still occupied at the time of our visit in early June. Located in a pleasant, clean, quiet neighborhood in Gladstone. One car attached garage and the rear one story portion of the home appear to be newer than the front section. Upper roof is steel, and lower/garage roof are shingled and appear to be in pretty decent con...

Vacant Platted Lot w/ Access Issues, Gladstone Area. Parcel has frontage on White Ave, an unbuilt platted road. Likely too small to be buildable, no practical use to anyone other than an adjacent property owner.

4 platted lots in the Gladstone area. Right off of US-41, although it appears to front only on unbuilt roads. According to plat maps, an unbuilt alley runs through the parcel. Please do your research on this one to ensure it is suitable for your intended use.
